source_rows.title: [RFC]: KV cache offloading
source_rows.reason: KV offloading architecture RFC, with explicit job_id/completion routing and metadata directions. Keep as an integration reference; no specific failing program or validated CoroPerf result.
source_rows.reason_zh: KV offloading 架构 RFC，提出明确 job_id、完成路由与元数据方向。保留为集成参考，没有具体失败程序或已验证 CoroPerf 结果。

possible_observations: Real submitted transfer job_id to scheduler request and KV-block ownership
Worker transfer Task/operation identity to completion response
Completion response back to scheduler admission and safe-to-free decision
vllm_integration_reference.limit: Task birth alone cannot establish GPU data residency, transfer completion or memory lifetime. Do not rerun existing successful offloading workloads through this RFC.
